امتنعتن (form VIII)
# اِمْتَنَعْتُنَّ (imtanaʕtunna) /im.ta.naʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# اُمْتُنِعْتُنَّ (umtuniʕtunna) /um.tu.niʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
